fact: Urbanism minister Mory Condé said street naming and addressing of Kaloum commune was done 100%, a geolocation app was already available and tested, and the programme would extend to other communes and serve security forces, civil protection, tax and utilities.
title: Adressage des rues à Kaloum : Les explications de Mory Condé, ministre l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat
